好玩~ 一玩就停不下来！ 以及，为什么恋恋三句话不离扒光魔理沙沙的衣服啊啊啊啊啊⁄(⁄ ⁄•⁄ω⁄•⁄ ⁄)⁄ 为什么恋恋又变成痴女啊啊啊啊啊 我为什么要说又啊啊啊啊啊

[h2]游戏概述[/h2] 《东方魔女夜市》是一款像素风的东方同人二创肉鸽游戏，你将扮演输光所有家产的「魔理沙」，收集各种魔法道具和技能，在夜市打败前来的敌人，赚钱还债。本作立绘可爱，道具构筑组合多样，可玩性高，可根据需求调节难度，单局大约20分钟，适合闲暇时刻玩上一把！ [h2]剧情[/h2] 黄发黑白小女孩「魔理沙」又双叒叕欠钱啦！魔理沙在“怕亲哥”里输光了一塌糊涂，甚至将自己所有的魔法道具都卖掉换钱，仍旧一分不剩！正巧幻想乡掀起了魔法道具战斗的浪潮，魔理沙想要在夜市里，凭借自己对魔法道具的优秀直觉，收集各种魔法道具和技能，打败前来讨债的各路不明强敌，从而将“借”来的钱用于还债。如果失败了，魔理沙或许将面临惨痛的教训！ [h2]特色[/h2] 本作作为一部肉鸽类型的游戏，你可以自由组合125种道具和48种技能。每局大约20分钟，你需要在这十天内搜集各种物品进行组合，并在夜晚击退来犯的强敌。每天有四个时间段，前三个时间段将会进入随机事件，你可以从三个随机事件中选择一个触发，或购买道具，或学习技能，或补充状态，或......大量的随机事件大大增加了每局游戏不同构筑的不确定性，肉鸽属性也充分得到发挥。 本作加入了大量东方系列角色的剧情，一些比较有意思的人物对话，同时也加入了许多与其他游戏的互动对话（如与《还书》、《异遇》的梦幻联动），制作组在文本方面还是比较有想法的。同时你还可以自定义战斗时的背景，将自己喜欢的贴纸放在上面作为装饰。 本作还为玩家提供了Extra模式和种子号。你可以将你的历史记录变成你要面对的敌人，也可以分享自己的存档给其他人或者导入其他人的存档，分享他人的构筑。 [h2]总结[/h2] 一款可玩性较高的像素风肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏，玩法多，文本有趣，同时价格也不贵，推荐给对东方同人游戏感兴趣的玩家。 [quote] 闲暇时光，不妨试试游戏。 欢迎关注[url=store.steampowered.com/curator/45653622/] 闲暇時光鉴赏组 [/url] [/quote]

[h1]《东方魔女夜市》简评[/h1] 本作是东方系列的一个的卡通肉鸽游戏，游戏有着背包构筑与自走棋的玩法设定，游戏的画风也是那种卡通可爱的像素风格，游戏玩法玩起来还是挺有意思的。 魔理沙因为“怕亲哥”而输掉了自己的钱，于是她找到灵梦，希望她能帮助自己，正巧因为幻想乡的无聊，开始流行起了魔法道具对决，直接点说就是用魔法道具PK，输家要给赢家钱，灵梦怕强大的妖怪参与其中导致幻想乡毁灭，于是想要魔理沙加入其中，在教训怪物的同时又能赚一大笔钱，魔理沙因为被抓住了把柄，也只能参与其中了，可怜的魔理沙被灵梦玩弄于鼓掌之中的故事开始了。 游戏有着种子与难度的设定，既然有种子，那么玩的方式就变得多种多样了，游戏难度可以根据游戏的熟知程度自行进行调节，在图鉴中玩家可以自由查看有关游戏玩法的物品，技能和敌人的相关数据，以便于更好的进行物品的搭配。 每天有四个时刻，通俗点来说就是玩家前期准备的操作只有四下，第一天玩家可以选择主要的玩法类型，第二天则可以根据前面的类型进行事件的选择，可以进商店购买物品，也可以选择技能宝箱，亦可以直接获取金币。第三天进行的是后续的选择，也是可以进行对战或者到商店购买物品，到了第四天，玩家可以从两名敌人中选择一位进行挑战，胜利则可以得到敌人的物品或技能，如果失败就会扣残机，玩家操控的角色有3点残机，简单点来说就是生命值，生命值归零，玩家也就失败了，战斗的方式玩家是不能操作的，不过如果对战斗不满可以进行SL。 总的来说，《东方魔女夜市》是一款玩法简单，容易上手的东方系列同人游戏，游戏的教程非常详细，与敌人对战的效率也是很高的，如果不能分出胜负还有系统杀，可以说是十分不错的，一把的时间也不会太长，有时候玩着玩着时间就过去了。 [quote] 专业评测 | 独立视角 | 帮你发现好游戏 欢迎关注 [url= https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45363287/]“🎮丨游戏高手鉴赏组丨🎮”[/url] [/quote]

Cool concept but it's just straight up not fun. First of all you can't progress through the story if you don't play on Lunatic Mode. Then on Lunatic mode, the game will through you opponent with builds that you won't see coming. They'll either just be able to create near unstoppable builds unless you have their specifc counter or being able to scale high enough, but you usually can't scale as much as the opponents as if they were cheating. Having a a run where you've crafted a decent set of items that synergizes well, only to be instantly stopped by some overpowerd opponent builds is just not fun, especially when you can't even know what the opponent builds are until you see them. Also the translation is not good at all, I can tolerate the use of machine translation but please, PLEASE get someone to proof read all the english text and item description. As of now there are a good number of items descriptions that are written in a way that you can't even identify what they do, and it does not help with the fact that you cannot slow down, pause of step during battle to learn from them. It is extremely important to make sure information is conveyed with zero ambiguity in these types of games. I am wiling to change my verdict later if these issues are addressed but as of now I just cannot in good faith reccommend this game. (note: I might write down a more in-depth review for the game with details of all issues I had with the game later, but I do want to get these problems voiced out for now) (Update: At this point I am too tired to replay this game and would rather play some more other well made indie games made by lesser known people. So I'll hold of my in depth review for this for a long time.)

The Bazaar, but it's like a bootleg DOTA arcade game with love. This is not a minus for me, but YMMV. After 8 hours, there has been less than a handful of unclear item descriptions, usually solved immediately by testing to see what it does. As for the story dialogue, it's way worse than the items, but it's translated in a way that makes most of the characters seem completely psychotic. From Remillia threatening to turn Marisa into black tea, to Reisen wanting to use Marisa's broom as a barbeque skewer. Again, this is by no means a minus for me. It's an honest game, free from greedy ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, that delivers a very similar experience to the Bazaar, with the only big difference being a low amount of players. You can help change that for just 5 bucks! (please help I have literally killed myself several times by randomly being against my own builds) EDIT: Turns out there's a setting for adding "Local" builds to the enemy pool. After beating Lunatic 3 times, you can choose to go full PvP like the Bazaar, mixed Local + Online builds, or Local only if you fancy trying to get better at whopping your own ass.

For $5 USD as a singleplayer alternative to The Bazaar? Yes, its worth the asking price. This doesn't play exactly the same - 8 slots instead of 10, shorter runs of 10 or 11 rounds, singleplayer with the option to play against stock or developer included builds (seasons?) or your own prior builds, a timeline system for activating slots instead of them being on independent cooldowns, and simplified ways to deal/mitigate damage. Burn does not decay over time in any way, Poison doesn't exist, and there's a loose meta of Burst DPS > Scaling DPS > Shield > Burst. Balance is about as good as can be expected. A min/maxxer will discover that there's a few strategies that are the most consistent, but there's also a lot of ways to experiment with niche builds. At the given price point, there's more meaningful variety here than I'd expect. Note that you have to play a tutorial Easy run and a few "Lunatic" clears before the intended "Lunatic EX" difficulty is available, and you'll want to tweak the EX settings to disable handicaps for a true run that doesn't hinder enemy boards to the player's benefit. I turned off the story immediately. Music is fine but repetitive. English translation is passable, but adds a bit more of a learning curve and there remain a few typos such as "Miedium->Medium". Still, after a few runs I felt I understood everything except "Shop Refresh Level" which I'm assuming makes shops generate higher rarities? Given that there isn't a real multiplayer competitor to The Bazaar and its atrocious decisions, this is a fun alternative that doesn't have the same staying power, but also doesn't ask near as much of its user - no dailies, no controversial monetization, no developer controversies that I'm aware of, etc...

For the price it's a fun homage to The Bazaar. If you're thinking of buying it anyway for the Touhou flavor, it might even serve as a good way to test whether you'll enjoy The Bazaar. This game's not that great, though. The item synergies are lacking, with some items requiring such specific combinations that they're useless without the full suite. That makes it harder to make a decent board out of the random items the game gives you. The lack of an upgrade system (buy duplicates of an item to increase its rarity + power) like in The Bazaar means that you have to eventually move on from common rarity items. Some early game items in The Bazaar can be carried into your final board, while here the starting items start being worthless past Day 4 or so. The poor translations make it almost impossible to understand how some of the more complex items work. With how cheap the game is, I don't think they'll improve this part.

Two main issues: 1. The story only progresses to the end on the hardest difficulty. Unfortunately, between the unfavourable RNG of getting good/synergising items and the over-the-top enemy builds, said difficulty is too hard. And since this is a rogue-like auto-battler with heavy RNG, it's not exactly FUN hard. 2. The machine translation means half the time you will be unable to guess what was mistranslated/misspelled unless you have enough 2hu lore knowledge to guess what the author meant. This is an even bigger problem for the gameplay, since you won't always be certain what a given attack/ability does due to ambiguous wording. Sure, you can theoretically trial-and-error every unclear description, but at that point you're either wasting time on a difficulty setting that's too easy just to uncover what stuff does or you suffer even more on the hardest difficulty due to issues mentioned in point 1. Maybe the game is actually much easier if the descriptions of attacks/abilities are easily understandable without any doubtful phrasing - I wouldn't know because I don't speak Chinese. Making the base story completable on hard (maybe adding a True Ending just for the hardest difficulty?) and a proofreading of the translation are needed before I could recommend this. Art is cute though. Chinese machine-translated review below so the devs can see it as well: 这是该评论的机器翻译版本，目的是让开发者更容易阅读（希望他们真的会看这些）： 两个主要问题： 1. 只有在最高难度下，故事才能推进到结局。不幸的是，在获取优质或有联动效果道具时较为不利的随机数（RNG），再加上敌人夸张的构筑，使得该难度实在是太难了。而且由于这是一款带有大量随机性的类 Rogue 自动战斗游戏，这种难度并不是“有趣的难”。 2. 机器翻译导致有一半时间你根本无法猜出哪些地方被误译或拼错，除非你对 2hu 的设定有足够了解，才能猜出作者本意。对于游戏玩法来说，这个问题更加严重，因为由于措辞含糊，你并不总能确定某个攻击或技能具体做什么。没错，从理论上讲你可以通过反复试错来弄清每条不清晰的描述，但那样的话，你要么是在过于简单的难度下浪费时间只为了搞清楚机制，要么因为第 1 点提到的问题，在最高难度下承受更多痛苦。 也许如果攻击/技能的描述能够清晰易懂、没有任何歧义，游戏实际上会容易得多——但我无法确定，因为我不会说中文。 在我愿意推荐这款游戏之前，需要让基础剧情在困难难度下也能通关（也许可以只为最高难度增加一个“真结局”？），并对翻译进行一次校对。 不过，美术还是挺可爱的。

游玩时间在3-10h就会坐大牢的游戏。 个人推测数值策划是过于依赖核心玩家在交流群的意见反馈做游戏了，以过去的自己通关阵容作为数据库+配套的存档机制和mod+未开放创意工坊，策划默认你要游玩数十个小时并加入讨论群才能获得的完整的游戏体验。 不打EX游戏1h入门2-3h全通，只要打EX就得重复有限的游戏内容到15h往上才有游戏体验。 EX会把你打L的历史阵容作为对手，策划鼓励你多流派多阵容反复通关L难度，并暗示你最好从外部获取别人的历史阵容存档集合加入已获得更好的EX体验，甚至通过污染通关数据库的方式降低EX难度。 但实际速刷L就会发现大部分较为随意的阵容根本无法通关L，功利化构筑流派阵容会让你的EX对手阵容变得单调且难打。 游戏给我呈现的观感就是鼓励核心玩家刷L难度获取EX对手数据库，然后围绕EX玩法做文章。游戏的大部分成就只有百分之几的人获得，策划得到的大部分反馈也来自这些玩家。看了一遍更新历程，我不认为未来的更新会照顾新玩家的轻度游戏体验。 打差评是我确实刷不下去了，评测的4h里从头通关L只花了1h不到，刷L阵容丰富度刷了3h，130次左右的重复只有3次指数叠层打通了关，对一个新玩家，自己尝试的绝大部分不依赖Key卡的阵容根本进不来EX阵容里，目测自己摸要玩到收放自如的构筑阵容通关还要刷取十几个小时，而游戏在字里行间的提示里认为这是理所应当的。 个人作为一名新玩家游戏体验过于割裂。

hard to put down once you start - but has notable flaws. translation isn't particularly good, but the art is amazing. the best play experience is on the highest difficulty, otherwise it's too easy. once you finish the main story (completing lunatic difficulty a few times), you unlock the best part of the game, the extra mode. extra mode is one where it draws off your own and other players runs for all the enemies. this makes things far less predictable, which is great in this kind of game. sadly, while the normal enemies are grouped into status effect focuses, this doesn't work on extra mode. it's all luck. no strategy for who you choose on extra - but it was kind of rock paper scissors anyway. speaking of which, there's only 3 status effects really. Shield, Damage, and Burn. there's a surprising number of options, but they have pretty defined key items that just take a few runs to learn what you need. as a final note, the DLC. not the most worth it. adds two new effects, and theyre kind of essential to use if you want to win with the new items enabled. only adds a very small amount of choice. overall though, very fun! just flawed.

这个游戏还算挺好玩，但是确实不想给好评。 买的时候看了一下介绍还有商店宣传的游戏画面，以为是融合了肉鸽模拟经营类的游戏，进来了才发现真的只是肉鸽自走棋（能考虑改个名吗）。故事背景里面说白天经营魔法道具商店晚上打架，白天那个经营魔法道具商店的感觉是一点没有的。讲真，要不是游戏挺好玩的真有种被骗进来杀的感觉。游戏难度感觉并不低，并且成就会不会难得太逆天了，build构筑是有，但是总感觉就是缺少几个关键buff的话这游戏就是牢完了，并且连胜要求还不允许刷开局。 好玩是确实挺好玩，但是好评确实是不想给好评。

好玩爱玩，mod开发也简单，就是玩的人少（） 大概玩法就是构建卡组，排牌序，然后会自动触发牌的效果。 牌的效果有造成伤害，给对面挂dot，给自己加盾，给自己加持续回复，增加以上效果的数值，更快触发效果，增加触发队列，暂时禁用一张对面的牌等。 局内成长系统也不错，可以通过出售牌给一些其他牌永久增加属性，通过各种技能和牌配合可以达成经济循环。 狠狠入！

真tm的好玩，不是我要说，真tm的实在好玩吔！（喜） 一开始上手会有理解门槛，但是只要玩多几轮，上手后就停不下来了，虽然组合个人觉得能用的强力的不算太多，但是只要胡了那就爽的飞起了（虽然变成敌人的时候也是哭的坠机（悲） 故事也蛮搞怪有趣的，和其他角色们的对话也有些东方梗混在一起，作为车万众真是令我欢喜口牙！ 而且作者还开了创意工坊，看来可以爽玩好一段时间了！ 综上所述，我个人认为不管是作为肉鸽爱好者，还是车万爱好者，都建议可以一试的作品！
